# Defect Report (generated by `python -m src.reporting`)

> SYNTHETIC data. The baseline is an INTENTIONALLY DEFECTIVE reference written for this assessment - not any employer's production code.

Method: each defect is measured by re-introducing it into the corrected engine one at a time (ablation) and comparing driver-day kilometres against the corrected result (134.324 km in-zone in total). Money uses the synthetic rate USD 0.80/km, driver payout 40%.

## Ranking (by absolute driver-day exposure)

| Rank | ID | Severity | Priority | Records | Net km | Abs driver-day km | Advertiser USD | Driver payout USD |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | D-ORDER | Critical | P0 | 104 | 168.446 | 168.456 | 134.760 | 53.900 |
| 2 | D-SPEED | Critical | P0 | 48 | 32.863 | 32.863 | 26.290 | 10.520 |
| 3 | D-GAP | High | P1 | 18 | 8.788 | 8.788 | 7.030 | 2.810 |
| 4 | D-NOISE | Medium | P2 | 72 | 2.329 | 2.329 | 1.860 | 0.750 |
| 5 | D-ZONE | Medium | P2 | 64 | -0.432 | 2.090 | -0.350 | -0.140 |
| 6 | D-PREC | Medium | P2 | 2694 | -0.016 | 1.040 | -0.010 | -0.010 |
| 7 | D-DAY | Medium | P2 | 4 | -0.000 | 0.595 | -0.000 | -0.000 |
| 8 | D-DUP | Medium | P2 | 72 | 0.365 | 0.365 | 0.290 | 0.120 |

Positive net km / USD = the defective logic OVER-bills the advertiser (and over-pays drivers); negative = under-billing.

**Reading the numbers:** impacts are *marginal* (one defect re-introduced at a time). Rules overlap and compound, so the rows do not sum to the full baseline error of the combined defects (e.g. a 400 m off-road ping also implies >150 km/h, so removing only the off-road rule changes little). All eight together reproduce the baseline exactly (tests/test_regression.py::test_ablation_of_all_rules_reproduces_baseline_exactly).

## Data anomalies found by the validator

- total records: 2894
- valid records: 2694
- rejected records: 200
- duplicate records: 72
- gps noise records: 72
- impossible speed records: 48
- invalid field records: 8
- out of order arrivals: 104
- late arriving records: 104
- missing interval segments: 18
- rejection reasons: {'DUPLICATE': 72, 'OFF_ROAD_GT_100M': 72, 'IMPOSSIBLE_SPEED_GT_150KMH': 48, 'INVALID_COORDINATES': 3, 'MISSING_FIELD': 3, 'INVALID_TIMESTAMP': 2}

## Findings

### 1. D-ORDER - Late / out-of-order pings processed in arrival order

- **Severity / priority:** Critical / P0
- **Violated rule:** Late and out-of-order pings must be placed according to their own timestamps.
- **Root cause:** The job iterates the file in arrival order (`groupby('driver_id', sort=False)` then `itertuples()`) and never sorts by `ts_utc`. A ping that arrives 2-15 minutes late is measured against the wrong neighbours: the path jumps back to its true position and forward again, so chord lengths of 1+ km are billed for 10-second segments.
- **Reproduction:** `python -c "from src.reporting import *; from src.distance_calculator import *; p=load_pings(); print(process(p, EngineConfig(**{'ordering': 'arrival'})).daily.km.sum() - process(p).daily.km.sum())"` (re-introduces only this defect); reproduced = True
- **Records affected:** 104
- **Affected drivers:** D001, D002, D003, D004, D005, D006, D007, D008, D009, D010, D011, D012
- **Distance impact:** net +168.446 km, absolute driver-day 168.456 km
- **Advertiser financial impact:** +134.76 USD; **driver payout impact:** +53.90 USD
- **Evidence from the dataset:**
  - D001: P002422->P002429 arrives 760s 'back in time'; straight-line jump of 10,107 m between two pings that are 10 s apart in real time
  - D007: P001654->P001656 arrives 810s 'back in time'; straight-line jump of 10,056 m between two pings that are 10 s apart in real time
  - D003: P002850->P002862 arrives 660s 'back in time'; straight-line jump of 9,140 m between two pings that are 10 s apart in real time
- **Fix status:** fixed in `src/distance_calculator.py`; **Regression status:** covered by tests/test_regression.py

### 2. D-SPEED - Impossible-speed pings (> 150 km/h) are billed

- **Severity / priority:** Critical / P0
- **Violated rule:** Pings implying a speed above 150 km/h must be ignored.
- **Root cause:** No speed check exists. A teleporting ping that sits ON the road (so an off-road filter alone would not catch it) adds a long out-and-back chord of 0.8-2 km.
- **Reproduction:** `python -c "from src.reporting import *; from src.distance_calculator import *; p=load_pings(); print(process(p, EngineConfig(**{'speed_filter': False})).daily.km.sum() - process(p).daily.km.sum())"` (re-introduces only this defect); reproduced = True
- **Records affected:** 48
- **Affected drivers:** D001, D002, D004, D005, D006, D007, D008, D009, D010, D011, D012
- **Distance impact:** net +32.863 km, absolute driver-day 32.863 km
- **Advertiser financial impact:** +26.29 USD; **driver payout impact:** +10.52 USD
- **Evidence from the dataset:**
  - D002 P002433: implied 720 km/h
  - D002 P002213: implied 659 km/h
  - D006 P001319: implied 658 km/h
- **Fix status:** fixed in `src/distance_calculator.py`; **Regression status:** covered by tests/test_regression.py

### 3. D-GAP - Distance billed across missing-ping gaps

- **Severity / priority:** High / P1
- **Violated rule:** Missing intervals must not be silently interpolated into billable distance (assumption A3).
- **Root cause:** Consecutive rows are joined regardless of elapsed time. After a 100 s or 300 s outage the straight line between the last and next ping is billed although the path (and whether the vehicle stayed in the zone) is unknown.
- **Reproduction:** `python -c "from src.reporting import *; from src.distance_calculator import *; p=load_pings(); print(process(p, EngineConfig(**{'gap_rule': False})).daily.km.sum() - process(p).daily.km.sum())"` (re-introduces only this defect); reproduced = True
- **Records affected:** 18
- **Affected drivers:** D002, D004, D006, D008, D010, D011, D012
- **Distance impact:** net +8.788 km, absolute driver-day 8.788 km
- **Advertiser financial impact:** +7.03 USD; **driver payout impact:** +2.81 USD
- **Evidence from the dataset:**
  - D006: P001538->P001639 gap 300s, straight line 4,306 m
  - D004: P002327->P002396 gap 300s, straight line 3,918 m
  - D008: P001347->P001430 gap 300s, straight line 3,299 m
- **Fix status:** fixed in `src/distance_calculator.py`; **Regression status:** covered by tests/test_regression.py

### 4. D-NOISE - GPS noise > 100 m off the road is billed

- **Severity / priority:** Medium / P2
- **Violated rule:** GPS pings more than 100 metres off the road path must be ignored.
- **Root cause:** No distance-to-road check. A ping 120-600 m off the road adds a detour of up to ~2x the offset; pings at 100.0 m must stay valid and 100.5 m must be dropped (strict `>`).
- **Reproduction:** `python -c "from src.reporting import *; from src.distance_calculator import *; p=load_pings(); print(process(p, EngineConfig(**{'offroad_filter': False})).daily.km.sum() - process(p).daily.km.sum())"` (re-introduces only this defect); reproduced = True
- **Records affected:** 72
- **Affected drivers:** D001, D002, D003, D004, D005, D006, D007, D009, D010, D011
- **Distance impact:** net +2.329 km, absolute driver-day 2.329 km
- **Advertiser financial impact:** +1.86 USD; **driver payout impact:** +0.75 USD
- **Evidence from the dataset:**
  - D008 P001300: 596 m from the road
  - D010 P000935: 595 m from the road
  - D003 P002131: 590 m from the road
- **Fix status:** fixed in `src/distance_calculator.py`; **Regression status:** covered by tests/test_regression.py

### 5. D-ZONE - Zone entry/exit billed with the END ping only

- **Severity / priority:** Medium / P2
- **Violated rule:** Distance counts only while the vehicle is inside the zone.
- **Root cause:** `zone.contains(row.lat, row.lon)` decides for the whole segment. The entry segment is over-billed (outside part counted), the exit segment is under-billed (inside part dropped).
- **Reproduction:** `python -c "from src.reporting import *; from src.distance_calculator import *; p=load_pings(); print(process(p, EngineConfig(**{'zone_mode': 'endpoint'})).daily.km.sum() - process(p).daily.km.sum())"` (re-introduces only this defect); reproduced = True
- **Records affected:** 64
- **Affected drivers:** D001, D002, D003, D004, D005, D006, D007, D008, D009, D010, D011, D012
- **Distance impact:** net -0.432 km, absolute driver-day 2.090 km
- **Advertiser financial impact:** -0.35 USD; **driver payout impact:** -0.14 USD
- **Evidence from the dataset:**
  - D003: P001966->P001967 correct in-zone 55.0 m, END-ping rule bills 416.7 m
  - D011: P000301->P000305 correct in-zone 34.2 m, END-ping rule bills 284.8 m
  - D005: P001556->P001561 correct in-zone 237.2 m, END-ping rule bills 0.0 m
- **Fix status:** fixed in `src/distance_calculator.py`; **Regression status:** covered by tests/test_regression.py

### 6. D-PREC - Coordinates rounded to 4 decimals before measuring

- **Severity / priority:** Medium / P2
- **Violated rule:** Distance calculation and GPS coordinate precision.
- **Root cause:** `df['lat'].round(4)` snaps pings to an ~11 m grid, perturbing every 10-second chord.
- **Reproduction:** `python -c "from src.reporting import *; from src.distance_calculator import *; p=load_pings(); print(process(p, EngineConfig(**{'coord_decimals': 4})).daily.km.sum() - process(p).daily.km.sum())"` (re-introduces only this defect); reproduced = True
- **Records affected:** 2694
- **Affected drivers:** D001, D002, D004, D005, D007, D009, D010, D011
- **Distance impact:** net -0.016 km, absolute driver-day 1.040 km
- **Advertiser financial impact:** -0.01 USD; **driver payout impact:** -0.01 USD
- **Evidence from the dataset:**
  - max coordinate displacement from rounding: 7.1 m; mean 3.8 m
  - rounding flips the accept/reject decision of 22 pings (edge cases at exactly 100 m / 150 km/h are the most fragile)
- **Fix status:** fixed in `src/distance_calculator.py`; **Regression status:** covered by tests/test_regression.py

### 7. D-DAY - Midnight-straddling segment assigned wholly to the END ping's day

- **Severity / priority:** Medium / P2
- **Violated rule:** Daily report cutoff; all timestamps in UTC.
- **Root cause:** The report date comes from the end ping only. A segment that straddles the daily cut is not split, so kilometres move between report days (net total unchanged, daily bills wrong).
- **Reproduction:** `python -c "from src.reporting import *; from src.distance_calculator import *; p=load_pings(); print(process(p, EngineConfig(**{'day_mode': 'end'})).daily.km.sum() - process(p).daily.km.sum())"` (re-introduces only this defect); reproduced = True
- **Records affected:** 4
- **Affected drivers:** D001, D002, D003, D004
- **Distance impact:** net -0.000 km, absolute driver-day 0.595 km
- **Advertiser financial impact:** -0.00 USD; **driver payout impact:** -0.00 USD
- **Evidence from the dataset:**
  - D001: P001992->P002232 23:59:53->00:00:03Z split 2026-03-14: 112.8 m, 2026-03-15: 48.3 m; legacy: all on 2026-03-15
  - D002: P001994->P002236 23:59:57->00:00:07Z split 2026-03-14: 45.7 m, 2026-03-15: 106.6 m; legacy: all on 2026-03-15
  - D003: P001991->P002231 23:59:54->00:00:04Z split 2026-03-14: 46.6 m, 2026-03-15: 31.1 m; legacy: all on 2026-03-15
- **Fix status:** fixed in `src/distance_calculator.py`; **Regression status:** covered by tests/test_regression.py

### 8. D-DUP - Duplicate pings (same driver + timestamp) are double counted

- **Severity / priority:** Medium / P2
- **Violated rule:** Duplicate pings for the same driver at the same timestamp must be collapsed.
- **Root cause:** No de-duplication on (driver_id, ts_utc). Duplicates whose coordinates differ by 15-40 m create a zig-zag between the copies.
- **Reproduction:** `python -c "from src.reporting import *; from src.distance_calculator import *; p=load_pings(); print(process(p, EngineConfig(**{'dedupe': False})).daily.km.sum() - process(p).daily.km.sum())"` (re-introduces only this defect); reproduced = True
- **Records affected:** 72
- **Affected drivers:** D002, D004, D005, D007, D010, D011, D012
- **Distance impact:** net +0.365 km, absolute driver-day 0.365 km
- **Advertiser financial impact:** +0.29 USD; **driver payout impact:** +0.12 USD
- **Evidence from the dataset:**
  - D012 P000005 duplicates an earlier ping at 2026-03-14T07:02:40Z
  - D011 P000021 duplicates an earlier ping at 2026-03-14T07:04:35Z
  - D011 P000076 duplicates an earlier ping at 2026-03-14T07:09:05Z
- **Fix status:** fixed in `src/distance_calculator.py`; **Regression status:** covered by tests/test_regression.py
